title: Casting an updated register assignment
statement: Let $rho:mathrm{Fin}(R)\tomathbb{N}$ be a register assignment, let $t$ be a register index, and let $m\inmathbb{N}$. Casting each value to an integer after replacing $rho(t)$ by $m$ gives the same function as first casting all values of $rho$ to integers and then replacing the value at $t$ by $m$.
hypotheses_covered: The label type is finite and has decidable equality
replaced:
Let $\rho : \{0, \dots, R-1\} \to \mathbb{N}$, let $t$ be an index and $m \in \mathbb{N}$, and let
$\rho'$ agree with $\rho$ except that $\rho'(t) = m$. Then replacing the $t$-th entry of the
integer vector $(\rho(r))_r$ by $m$ gives the integer vector $(\rho'(r))_r$.
